simulationVersion.title: M4b proxy v1 · single capsule
simulationVersion.description: One dynamic vertical capsule per player; 3D rotation and contacts are solver-resolved.

setup.playerGeometry: One dynamic vertical capsule per player; 3D rotation and contacts are solver-resolved.

solverIterations.jolt: package default; JS wrapper setting not exposed in this harness

setup.forceModels: bounded balance torques, configured player drive forces, torso-anchor compliant wrap forces, and a carry-cradle force pair are separately recorded.
setup.football: rounded-box rigid-body proxy; carry is a force-based fixture, loose-ball contacts are real rigid-body contacts, secure recovery is unresolved without articulated hands.
setup.playerArticulation: single capsule or five-part rigid compound; neither model has articulated limbs.
